text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, at the riverbank...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! I win again! Still undefeated! ♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Augggh, damn it! Why can't I win?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Teio and I are skippin' rocks, but I keep
on losing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
At first it was just 'cause we were bored,
but after
a while, things got serious.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know anything about skipping
rocks, but
now that I've given it a try, it's
a lot of fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You just give them a little toss and they go zooooom! Feels great when you get it just right!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How did you get so much better than
me?! We
were on the same level when
we started!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Probably because I'm the Invincible Teio!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! I don't want to admit it, but that
was a super
cool line...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer! What can I do to beat Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer! What can I do to beat Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The perfect rock? You mean the biggest
one I can
find, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I teach Vodka all about what to look for
in a
rock, including the best shape and
weight for
skipping.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so that's how ya do it... I was just
using
jagged ones before 'cause they
looked cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll go look for a good one!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Look as hard as you like. It's not
like you're
gonna beat me anyway!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka, ever earnest, follows my advice
and looks
carefully for a perfectly
shaped rock. And so...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Your time has come! Go forth and fly...
Great
Golem Juniooor!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! It flew all the way to the other
side of
the river!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Pheeew! Hell yeah! I got my first win!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you beat my perfect
record... I
won't let you get away with
this!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's go again, Vodka! This time, I'll
prove that
you just got lucky!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're on! No way my Great Golem the
Third is
gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I end up watching them skip rocks until
the sun
goes down.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I gotcha! Just like with throwin' a
ball, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, now let's give this a shot!
Check this
out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sigh... She's definitely gotten the wrong idea here.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I bet she'll spin her whole body instead
of just the
rock!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And as we predicted...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All riiiiight! Time for the Vodka Screw
Maaax!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Wait! Whoa! My legs can't keep
u—aaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splaaaaash!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Called it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Vodka! It's no fun if you're so
predictable!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sh-shut up and help me already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After we get Vodka out of the water, I
teach her
how to use her wrist to put
spin on her rock.
